LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_III.label: umbral television
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_III.description: An incomparably massive entertainment device. Tenebrite Crystal Displays coupled with auditory suites of the highest caliber sometimes fool people into forgetting they're watching a movie, TV show, or video game.
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_III.label: umbral telescope
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_III.description: A telescopic array designed to monitor and observe potential threats to Tenebral claims, though its extensive scanning capabilities alongside the dizzying levels of zoom lend itself to recreational stargazing perfectly. It was never intended to see any form of danger, and can only be used outdoors as a result.
LanguageData.BOR_PC_III.label: umbral personal computer

Comes with a free copy of DOOM and gives a massive boost to learning after use.
